description: Run Azure CLI (`az`) commands against the LocalStack Azure emulator. The tool keeps its own Azure CLI profile, logged in to the emulator with a dummy account, so your own Azure login is never used or changed. Relative file paths resolve against the server's working directory (LOCALSTACK_AZ_WORKDIR), and a leading `~` in any argument is your home directory. For an operation without a command, use `rest` with a relative URL; `rest` reaches the emulator and other local hosts only. Start the emulator with `localstack-management` (service: azure).

command.description: One Azure CLI command, with or without the leading `az`, for example `group create --name demo --location westeurope`. No shell syntax: no pipes, `&&`, redirects or `$(...)`.

name: localstack-azure-client
title: LocalStack Azure Client
